name: Jonathan Smith
headline: Keeps the northern depots running
about: Runs the night shift rota out of the Trafford Park depot. Wants to talk about pallet tracking before the new year.

name: Katherine O'Connell
headline: Brand systems and type
about: Redrew the whole identity in six weeks and kept the old wordmark as an easter egg on the invoices.

name: Siobhan Murphy
headline: Forecasting and demand models
about: Built the demand model that replaced the spreadsheet nobody could open. Prefers a phone call to a meeting.

name: Krzysztof Nowak
headline: Customs and port clearance
about: Knows every customs officer between Gdansk and Rostock by first name. Answers email at five in the morning.

name: Aoife Gallagher
headline: Outpatient pathway redesign
about: Cut the outpatient waiting list by a third without hiring anybody. Writes very short emails.

name: Geoffrey Thwaite
headline: Steel finishing and heat treatment
about: Third generation at the same works. Will show you the annealing line if you ask nicely.

name: Xiomara Reyes
headline: Storage and grid connection
about: Spends her week arguing with the grid operator about connection queues. Very good at it.

name: Bartholomew Quigley
headline: Commercial contracts
about: Reads every schedule twice and finds the clause nobody else did. Hates video calls.

name: Anneliese Hofmann
headline: Motion control firmware
about: Wrote the motion controller that the whole product line still runs on. Keeps a paper notebook.

name: Padraig O'Callaghan
headline: Hydrographic survey
about: Maps estuary channels for a living. Has strong views about single beam versus multibeam.

name: Marcus Delgado
headline: Owns the tracking product
about: Took the pallet tracking product from a pilot to eleven depots in a year. Asks for the numbers first.

name: Priya Raghunathan
headline: Routing and optimisation
about: Rewrote the routing solver over one winter and halved the fuel bill. Reviews every pull request properly.

name: Tomas Lindqvist

about: The person clients actually call. Keeps a running list of everything the studio promised.

name: Nadia Benali
headline: Platform and data infrastructure

name: Declan McGrath

about: Produces the waiting list report the board actually reads. Will not round a number to make it look better.

name: Yuki Tanabe
headline: Owns the industrial arm line
about: Came from the factory floor into product and it shows in every spec she writes.

name: Oliver Brandt
headline: Project finance for storage

name: Renata Costa
headline: Substation design

name: Hassan Farouk
headline: Privacy and data protection
about: The person every team asks before they collect anything. Answers within the hour, always.

name: Ingrid Solberg
headline: Runs the freight operation
about: Took over an operation losing money and turned it round without laying anybody off.

name: Elena Vasquez
headline: Enzyme engineering

name: Samuel Adeyemi
headline: Application security

name: Mireia Puig
headline: Keeps the large accounts happy

name: Lukas Meyer
headline: Installs and calibrates in the field
about: Spends half the year on mountain sites. Ski touring is not a hobby so much as a commute.

name: Grace Okonkwo
headline: Soil and yield programmes

name: Felix Bergstrom
headline: Certification and carbon accounting

name: Amara Diallo
headline: Non fiction list

name: Diego Ferreira
headline: Structural survey

name: Hanna Virtanen
headline: Distributed systems
about: Wrote the consensus layer. Swims in the sea in February and considers this normal.

name: Rafael Moreno
headline: Builds the sites

name: Katherine Ashworth
headline: Residential interiors

headline: Fleet maintenance

name: Alexandra Petrova
